title: With a deposit held, Change Customer that keeps the Bill To goes through
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, picked by hand as the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, the new customer, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer C, where customer C was picked on the Customer card, holding a $10.00 deposit taken under customer C.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
  4. Pick customer D.
  5. Confirm the change.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 3:

  • The Change Customer button is enabled and the customer picker opens.

Step 4:

  • Customer D is picked.

Step 5:

  • The change goes through: the work order's customer is customer D.
  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.
  • The $10.00 deposit is still on customer C's Deposits tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits), story SV-12308 (Story 6, Change Customer with a Bill To)

  • S6-R3: “The existing deposit block on Change Customer applies only when the change would change the Bill To.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Change Customer | Allowed. A default Bill To follows, a picked one stays. Deposits block only if the Bill To would change. | As today; the invoice keeps its Bill To. A self-billed document stays self-billed. | As the Internal Work Orders PRD”
  • Key Decisions: “Deposits lock the Bill To. A deposit belongs to the Bill To it was taken under and never moves between customers. The refusal names the amount and payer and opens the payer's Deposits tab. A payment may use only deposits and credits held by the paying customer.”
